title: feat(oci-build): expose rc_version and changed outputs
body: ## Summary Adds `rc_version` and `changed` workflow outputs to the reusable `oci-build.yaml` workflow so that callers can consume the computed RC version string for chart publishing. This enables downstream repos (tech-ops-docs, hriv) to publish Helm charts with the same version tag as the app image on every main push, keeping chart and app versions in lockstep. **New outputs:** - `rc_version` — Full RC version string (e.g. `1.2.3-rc.20260414194220.b286051`). Empty when no changes detected. - `changed` — Whether changes were detected in the component's build context. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Verify the new outputs are wired correctly: `jobs.build.outputs.rc_version` maps from `steps.version.outputs.rc_version`, and `changed` from `steps.changes.outputs.changed` - [ ] Confirm that existing callers (hriv, tech-ops-docs) are not broken by the addition of outputs (outputs are purely additive) - [ ] After merging, verify the companion PRs in tech-ops-docs and hriv can successfully consume the outputs ### Notes This PR must be merged **before** the companion PRs in `bcit-tlu/technical-operations-documentation` and `bcit-tlu/hriv` that add helm-publish jobs consuming these outputs. Until this is merged, the `rc_version` output will be empty in those repos (the new helm-publish jobs are guarded by a non-empty check and will gracefully skip). Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/c9c8c3ce533d4ff88d5015f0d9b32edb Requested by: @kphunter ---
